purpose: Presents a trigger-driven popover list of actions or choices, with optional grouping, selection, rich item content, and submenus.

notes: VeliProvider supplies popover language and direction; English LTR is the fallback.

useWhen: A trigger opens a compact list of actions.
Users select one or more choices from a popover.
Actions need sections, separators, descriptions, shortcuts, or nested submenus.

avoidWhen.situation: A single prominent action can be shown directly.
avoidWhen.guidance: Expose the action as a button instead of hiding it in a menu.

avoidWhen.situation: Users switch between persistent content panels.
avoidWhen.guidance: Use tabs for persistent peer content.

approvedPatterns: Compose MenuTrigger, a trigger control, MenuPopover, Menu, and MenuItem.
Use sections and separators to group related actions.
Use danger intent for destructive items.
Use descriptions, icons, and shortcut hints for richer action context.
limitations: Shortcut content is a displayed hint; command handling remains the consumer's responsibility.
Long rich content may require a consumer-supplied popover width cap.
accessibility: Provide an accessible name for menus when the trigger does not label the choices clearly.
React Aria supplies menu keyboard navigation and selection semantics.
Disabled and selected item states are exposed through React Aria.
responsive: Item sizes support dense and spacious contexts.
Constrain popover width when descriptions are long.
rtl: Popover language and direction follow VeliProvider.
Consumer-supplied submenu carets should mirror for RTL.
